payload.taskDescription: Create tags.ts with normalizeTag, addTag, removeTag, and validateTagSet. Enforce trim, 24 characters, 10 tags per card, case-insensitive duplicate rejection, and preservation of the first display casing. Build TagInput with Enter/comma add, Backspace remove, a counter, announced errors, and 44px remove buttons. Wire TagInput into NoteSourceForm, TopicForm, and CardDetailPage so tags persist with the card and survive reload. Do not add search or filters.
